data.name: Ikramul
data.gender_notes: Ikramul is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Hindi words ‘Ikra’ (power) and ‘Mul’ (root), the name Ikramul signifies a strong, powerful individual. The name Ikramul carries the meaning “Powerful, Strong” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindi tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Ikramul usually hope their child will grow to embody powerful, strong and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Ikramul belongs to the Hindi linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Powerful, Strong.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ikramul total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

In Hindu culture, names are not just labels but represent the traits and ideals a person is expected to embody throughout their life. A name like Ikramul, encapsulating power and strength, is sure to inspire confidence and respect in society.
data.spiritual_significance: In the spiritual context, the name Ikramul holds a deeper meaning. The term ‘Ikra’ symbolizes the pressure or force needed to remove obstacles hindering personal growth and spiritual advancement. As such, the name Ikramul signifies an individual with the drive and resilience to overcome challenges and obstacles, and to progress on their spiritual journey. embracing the strength within to continue along their spiritual path despite difficulties and obstacles.
